notes.title: The Burst update 1.0.42 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Greetings operatives! The Burst update 1.0.42 is finally live! 

We got a bunch of cool stuff for you! What kinds of stuff, exactly, you might ask?
Well, many of you were waiting for them, and THEY FINALLY ARRIVED!
The highlights of our show... give a round of applause tooooo...
SPRINT BUTTON and JUMP BUTTON! Woooo!
We have also brought you a whole ton of weapon updates, movement fixes, and we have also eradicated a bunch of those pesky bugs that have been roaming around Damag! As always, if you're interested in the whole list of changes, read them down below!


Gameplay
Fixed voice recorders initial state
Fixed Sniper Ratata sometimes becoming jammed, requiring multiple rebolts
Fixed Sniper Ratata model and its LODs
Fixed scope sizes and colors to improve visibility
Reworked SAP energy mechanism, now it works correctly. Nova's special SAP now fires after trigger pull and not release
Reworked flamethrower sound
General weapon handling and performance improvements
General weapon mesh and animation improvements
Fixed ammo drop rate chance
Balance tweaks to all the weapons
Fixed stuttering when walking over small elevations
Improved ammo drop chance for supply boxes
Increased vehicle suspension haptics treshold to reduce constant bumping when dirivng over rough terrain
Implemented stability graph for compound constructions to prevent parts from floating in air when their base is broken
Improved vehicle damage to compound constructions
Imporoved hammer prop handling
Fixed stick crouching option not working
Added stick-sprint option to toggle sprinting by clicking on movement stick
Fixed flamethrower not having any sound on android platform
Increased jump height from sliding
Simplified jump code, now player can jump in any direction
Added easy jump option which removes need to swing hands to jump higher
Improved enemies grenade throwing behavior. Now enemies won't throw grenades in close proximity to themselves and other allies
Fixed Boom-Rifle and Revolver mags not displaying correct ammo count
Fixed mag duplication when ejecting a mag, putting it on a belt and taking it back to refill
Fixed enemies aiming incorrectly
Fixed subtitles showing incorrectly in certain dialogues
Improved AI reloading behavior

Graphics
Disabled Round-Robin occlusion queries
Fixed vehicle animation occasionally misplacing wheels
Fixed missing overlays on smooth spectator (PC)
Smooth spectator now renders projection from user's eye, rather than center of the HMD

Levels
Optimized crowded ending scene
Fixed visibility issues of objects that are under crane at Lead Lair
Fixed incorrect precomputed visibility and streaming at Lead Lair
Fixed background objects at Lead Lair
Improved performance on Mobile platforms at Forgepolis
Fixed misplaced LOD placeholders at prologue
Fixed toilet lid cover position in prologue
Fixed tutorial interruption logic
Fixed Varg hooks clipping through objects
Fixed some tape locations in Landing Zone
Improved audio volume levels in Bordergate
Fixed some precomputed visibility issues at various locations
Fixed some breakable constructions in Bordergate
Improved ending scene performance
Fixed player softlocking by leaving Varg's elevators
Fixed player falling through Varg's elevator roof when extensively jumping
Fixed Varg's elevator going back
Fixed lighting issues at Bunker
Fixed visibility and lighting issues at Forgepolis
Fixed Techkiller bosses spawn logic
Redesigned checkpoints and fall triggers at The Wall level
Fixed collision issues on cave supports
Fixed fog blending inside Bunker's vents
Fixed incorrect lightmap behaviour at train levels
Fixed reflection probes and, culling and collision at Bordergate
Fixed object culling at Leadlair
 
Menu
Fixed menu scroll direction inputs

Audio
Fixed dry fire clicks having no attenuation

Localization
Fixed localization of the  driving tutorial

notes.title: The Burst version 1.0.32 is out!
notes.notes:
Greetings operatives!

I come bearing great news! We now have full bHaptics support!
That's right! Now you can feel everything that poor Hornet feels! Getting shot, falling into the abyss, blowing up, crashing your mirage into a ton of explosives! Sounds like an amazing experience! Right?

Oh, and by the way, there's a whoooole lot of other things we cooked with this new version! One of those things are... ACHIEVEMENTS!!! That's right, they're finally here! Also we've done some requested enemy improvements and much, MUCH more!

Anyways, im sure you're curious about what exacrlty we did and what feedback we implemented, so here's a full list of everything!

Gameplay


 Armor debris collision is fixed — the player can no longer stand on armor pieces
 ACHIEVEMENTS
 Enemy accuracy is now range-dependent
 Enemies now react faster if they lose sight of the player
 Enemies now play turn animations correctly
 Several climbing issues were fixed
 Elevator buttons now have better visibility and differ in color
 The player’s hand no longer disappears when reloading a save with a weapon in hand
 The climbing is now more stable
 Varg’s hooks are now easier to access
 Syringes no longer affect cutscenes and their buffs are removed before the cutscene starts
 Enemy troops are now more mobile
 Enemy accuracy now depends on the player’s mobility — increases for standing targets, decreases for moving targets
 Enemy recoil is now both vertical and horizontal
 Actions leading to enemies dying are now registered correctly
 Several enemy animations were updated
 Several issues related to hook-dash ability were resolved
 The final boss now properly stops before dying
 Health and armor values for bosses underwent balance changes
 Enemy fire rate was rebalanced
 Enemies no longer yeet themselves to space after jumping
 Heavy enemies now have their jogging animation fixed
 Some enemies were mistakenly unhookable before. Not anymore.
 Melee enemies that can push now look for cover if the player is unreachable
 Took away teleportation tricks from enemies. Now they jump over obstacles properly.


Level Art


 Several annoying broken collisions, fog and flying objects were fixed in the Bunker mission
 Fixed distance culling of some meshes at Leadlair
 Missing gameplay sublevel in the Bunker mission is now restored
 Prologue underwent some minor fixes
 Cull distances at Bordergate now work better
 Track Owner no longer talks to the player after you escape the track
 Light mobility at Forgepolis was improved
 Proxies at Bordergate now work properly


Graphics


 FBAR magazine LODs were fixed
 Upgrade case now has better interior textures, its visibility was significantly improved
 SFX/VFX
 Flying enemy VFXs are now smoother


Bhaptics


 Landing (a slight vibration at the bottom of the torso)
 Wind (on the vehicles too!)
 Sliding along the floor (back haptics activation)
 Grabbing objects and surfaces
 Shooting
 Hook swinging and release haptics (depends on overall hook stress when swinging)
 Inventory interactions (belt and back slots)
 Taking damage from bullets, explosions and melee attacks
 Falling into the abyss (vibration all over the suit)
 Death (vibration all over the suit)
 Low health (heartbeat)
 Mirage engine start
 Running something (or someone) over and crashing
 Front and back mirage suspension bumping


That is going to be all for now, operatives. Stay tuned, something's coming ;)

notes.title: VISUAL UPDATE IS FINALLY HERE
notes.notes:
Operatives!

I’m pleased to finally announce that the Visual Update for THE BURST is now LIVE!

Hope you didn’t have to wait for too long! To sweeten the pill a 25% discount is available starting today, October 4th, 10 AM PDT and will last for 14 days!

As we promised, almost every aspect of the game was enhanced in one way or another: gameplay, level art, graphics and effects!

We also delivered on our other promise - THE UPDATED DEMO FOR THE BURST WILL GO LIVE TODAY just a bit later, hour-two most.

Jump on your Mirage, greet Shelldogs with rapid fire as they finally leave the Damag rehab center and touch THE NEW AND IMPROVED WALL!

Bug fixes, bot behavior improvements, lots of environmental detailing, but that is not all.

The Burst now supports bHaptics! Even more immersion for an epic postapocalyptic experience! We will be adding more events to the already existing list in upcoming patches. Feel free to send your feedback to us!

Unfortunately, the long-awaited achievements will have to wait a little bit… They are almost here, but as some of them require a bit more tuning, we will be sure to add them over the course of the next week.

Check us out and don’t forget to leave a review so we could work even harder and make the game even better!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/52ccd7a760bc48d11d54918d664cd89987ac0c55.png

For those of you curious enough, here is our full changelog:

Gameplay

-Flying enemies are now more precise
-Shelldogs no longer fall off containers in Utopia’s lair
-Subtitles no longer fade if the line goes on but the scene changes
-Hornet’s comments on his own decisions now correspond to the path he took
-Ghouls’ animations were tweaked
-Player now respawns correctly if they die/fall while driving Mirage
-Enemies learned how to jump properly
-Armored enemies can now be spiked
-Machinegunners now show a bit more of common sense in combat
-Enemies no longer get stuck when spawned
-Machinegunners, snipers and basic shooters passed their ballistic training and now target the player properly
-Scientists no longer  freeze in strange poses (being scared is not a valid excuse, old man!)
-Ladders are now easier to climb
-Enemies are no longer indecisive if they are too close for shooting and too far for melee
-Fixed rigor mortis causing guns to stick to enemies’ hands and turning them into ragdolls
-Armored enemies now have their both feet firmly on the ground
-Game no longer crashes when you try to hook an object
-Enemies now stand up properly
-Enemies passed their grade school exams with flying colors
-Some enemies had their armor rebalanced
-Crane position is now displayed properly
-Enemies are no longer airwalking if the tile underneath was broken
-Jumping tutorial was updated
-Boomsquad DMR “Spiker” was added to the arsenal (UCE archives don’t have info on it yet, but we will add it soon)
-Enemies now use cover more efficiently
-Mags and props no longer appear frozen
-Mirage wheels are now more stable and won’t jump randomly
-Mirage no longer spawns locked
-Flashbacks no longer corrupt save files
-Enemies now properly support their gun with their left hand
-Grenades now work as intended
-Items no longer spawn outside of boxes assigned to them
-Yellow box debris no longer prevents the player from taking the contents of the said box
-Items retain their velocity when the player is in motion and throws it
-Bosses now properly traverse their arenas
-Enemies are now better at closing distance
-Crane shows improvement in behavior and pathfinding (it can smell you)
-Utopia now dies properly
-The player’s hands no longer tremble or collide in silly ways while reloading and running
-Flying enemies won’t try to use jetpacks if they were destroyed or disabled
-Snipers and flyboys now have their assigned armor
-Items no longer fly away if you hook them with two hands
-Breaking structures will no longer cause a crash
-Belt slot positioning was tweaked
-Player can no longer duplicate mags by stacking them in the belt

Level-art

-Intro level streaming no longer causes lighting issues
-Level instances no longer unload too early
-Reflection probes are now updated
-Level LODs on multiple levels are now updated
-Intro sequence reflections, caves, background meshes and proxies on various levels show significant improvement
-General level art improvements - no more holes, flying objects or objects with broken collision
-Lighting, navigation and precomputed visibility were improved on many levels
-Train station level design was changed to add to fluidity of the boss battle. The train itself was slightly restructured.
-Bunker level art underwent some changes
-Leadlair cull distances were tweaked
-Burrowcamp level now can flex its ember and smoke particles
-The Wall level story scenes now activate properly
-Bordergate elevator puzzle now has an additional hint
-Smoke effects were integrated in The Wall level
-The carpet in Leadlair no longer bugs out
-Droppod textures are now updated (look for a cute new monitor to track your descent)
-Bordergate is now a windy place
-The Wall is now more detailed
-Road meshes were changed
-Road to the City enemy positioning is now a bit better
-Forgepolis background placeholders now apply properly
-Ending slides will now recognize correctly if [spoiler]Utopia[/spoiler] is dead or not
-Added more spots where enemies can jump and climb over obstacles
-Culling issues for Burrowcamp and Leadlair chapters were fixed

Graphics

-Placeholders are no longer visible from the other side during streaming
-Utopia no longer has multiple pairs of eyes, that was freaky even for her
-General visual improvements on many levels, including but not limited to everything described in the previous passage. From Droppod to Bunker, a lot of textures are now more detailed
-Debris no longer flies too far away

SFX/VFX

-Music no longer cuts off during the final cutscene of the first mission
-Distant effects now show proper sprite rotation
-Some bottles now have liquid
-Bottle shaders were also improved
-Bottles with liquid break with a distinct sound
-Grabbing now feels smoother
-Armor hit SFX is now more juicy
-Rocket trails on The Wall level have better visibility
-Entfant spores look a bit different now
-When bullets whoosh by your ear, you will hear it
-Varg soundtrack timings are now to the point
-Enemy footsteps sound even better now
-Sand shock wave effects for Leadlair, Train and The Wall scenes were enhanced.

General

-bHaptics is now supported!
-Peripherals and corresponding settings can be accessed through the menu
-New tutorials for breaking crates, activating grenades, opening upgrade boxes and pulling yourself to enemies are now added to the game
-New Era ending has its actors properly assigned
-Russian localization for prologue lever tutorial is now fixed

notes.title: The Burst Update 1.0.12!
notes.notes:
In the past week we received a tremendous amount of feedback from all of you guys, and we are extremely grateful for it!

We went through every message (literally) and tried to answer each of them to the best of our abilities.

The first patch is FINALLY HERE bringing many fixes to both PCVR and Quest!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/882096c4124d19e3285bee6ebd00e4c41a223990.png

notes.title: Demo Patch #1 NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
Player Character
- You can run on more walls now.
- The animation for standing up after landing on the high ground became smoother.
- You can now lean over objects.
- Objects are easier to grab now.
- You are less likely to slip after landing on the edge of a platform.
- Removed two of Nova's voicelines in the last section of the demo

Optimization
- Improved CPU performance for the grappling hook.
- Improved CPU performance for explosive barrel VFX.

Graphics
- The demo now uses DirectX 12 (Shader Model 6) instead of DirectX 11.

Interactions
- Fixed some grappling hook interactions with levers, rings and hooks.
- Broken props and joints will no longer stay attached to the grappling hook.
- Chipper (enemy secondary weapon) has several new grip positions.
- Supply crates are now easier to break.
- Rope physics are more stable and predictable.

Input
- Added an option to toggle the grip button for climbing and grabbing.
- Made it harder to trigger false grip on Index Controllers.
- Increased the slide window before landing after falling from great height.
- Menu can now be accessed by pressing the Right Menu on HTC Vive.
- You can now Jump by pressing the Right Trackpad Down on HTC Vive.
- You can now eject a magazine by pressing the Right Trackpad Up on HTC Vive
- Fixed a visual bug that affected “Controls” menu input for HTC Vive Controllers.
- Fixed a bug when a grappling hook would activate randomly while swinging.

Level Design
- Certain pits or falls will trigger your death properly now.
- Parkour sections before the hideout received some visual improvement.
- Mirage (vehicle) won’t get stuck on the ramp before the hideout.
- Some cave textures were redesigned.
- Several minor visual bugs were fixed.

Tutorials
- Several tutorial videos were tweaked. Removed the sound of the tutorial window closing.
- The currently active tutorial will not affect other tutorials anymore.
- Added a line describing the Turn Mode in the tutorial.

Enemies
- Only staggered enemies can now be thrown on spikes.
- Enemies will now properly follow the player’s position.
- Enemies will now become aggressive after being hit with a weapon in melee.
- Minor AI improvements.
- Enemies will no longer die when their armor piece falls into a pit.
- Improved the AI logic for the last segment of the game. Drivers got their license.
- Enemies no longer get stuck on one of the arenas.
- Enemies now reach for their holster before equipping a new weapon.
- Added SFX and VFX when enemies get spiked.
- Added additional SFX for enemies receiving damage in melee.
